title: Class pages that show, not tell (Item and List) are ready to merge

owner_note.text: The Item and List pages now open on the class in one line, a live one, a picture of how a change gets saved, and their test drawn step by step (all pass, and node runs the same steps). Each method is a card that opens its own page with a live example. It's reviewed and ready to merge on worktree/class-docs, after build B, but not merged. One choice was made for you: method notes live in the existing doc/method/ files rather than a new methods/ folder, so there is one home, not two.
